setup.title: Initialize Trunkline
setup.subtitle: Three steps to finish setup, then sign in with your admin account
setup.localDesc: Use the embedded H2 database stored in the local data directory. Best for a quick trial or a single-node deployment.
setup.remoteDesc: Connect to an external PostgreSQL database. Best for multi-instance and production deployments.
setup.restartDesc: Connection details are saved. Restart Trunkline so it switches to PostgreSQL; this page will continue to step 3 afterwards.
setup.refreshFail: The service has not switched to PostgreSQL yet. Confirm the restart and check the connection details.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters; include upper/lowercase letters, digits and symbols
setup.finishOk: Admin created. Redirecting to sign in…
setup.statusLoadFail: Could not read setup status. Please confirm the service is running.
setup.securityNote: Setup endpoints are open only until the first admin is created, then close automatically.
setup.restartLocalTitle: Restart required to switch back to local mode
setup.restartLocalDesc: The service is still connected to PostgreSQL. Restart it to return to the embedded H2 database, then create the admin.
